scope: Select web choices and hear full sentences.

topics.title: A shorter echo pause
details: The added pause before speech reads back your text is now 0.2 seconds. It was 0.35 seconds. Speech still waits for the current voice to finish.

topics.title: Hear the full sentence
details: Sentence echo keeps all the phrases you speak before a full stop. A pause no longer drops the first part of the sentence. Stop speech or change tasks to clear old readback.

topics.title: Choose a booking service
details: Native radio buttons and checkboxes use their normal Space action. A label or a details button over the choice no longer blocks a mouse click.
On booking sites, choose a service first. The site can then load dates and times. Dates marked No information before that choice are not yet ready. The app still reports dates the site disables.
